input_manifest.usage: Local league match prediction research; no open redistribution license assumed

specification.failure_policy: Fail on incomplete season, invalid score/result, duplicate fixture, nonfinite probability or failed optimizer. Preserve diagnostics; do not silently omit matches or replace models.

inherited_elo.inactive_team_policy: retain last rating; unseen teams start neutral; no lower-league information
inherited_elo.probability_mapping: multinomial LogisticRegression C=1, solver=lbfgs, max_iter=1000, tol=1e-8; same rolling fit IDs as Dixon-Coles; no posthoc calibration

specification.inherited_refit: first forecast day of each calendar two-month bucket: Jan-Feb, Mar-Apr, May-Jun, Jul-Aug, Sep-Oct, Nov-Dec

blocks: nonoverlapping 28-calendar-day blocks anchored to each season's first fixture date
inherited_uncertainty.interpretation: conditional uncertainty within these two historical seasons; not independent-season generalization, prospective evidence, or multiple-comparison-adjusted discovery
inherited_uncertainty.stratification: resample blocks independently within each season; preserve season match-count weights

specification.known_exposure: These league files have not been used in this research cycle; historical public data are not claimed universally unseen or prospective. EPL results motivated this fixed transfer test.
limitations: two leagues and two target seasons each
historical source revisions not point-in-time archived
club names as provided without retrospective alias mapping
conditional fixed-block uncertainty does not establish independent future-season transfer
specification.local_time_policy: Same day-start forecast and next-local-midnight result availability policy, with each league local timezone replacing Europe/London; no original vendor publication/revision archive.
specification.parameter_inheritance: Unchanged EPL DC365/Elo50 hyperparameters, likelihood and support math, 1095-calendar-day fit window, bimonthly cadence, causal Elo updates, fixed0.5 mixture. Equal DC uses identical fit IDs. No dc_180 fitting or new candidate selection.
specification.reporting: Fixed selected mixture vs equal DC only, per league and season; paired 28-day block95%interval, stratified by season. Pooled estimate stratified by league-season. No transfer-label-driven tuning.

findings.meaning: resumption/completion date, starting in minute17 after earlier0-0 interruption
resumption/completion date, starting in minute72 after earlier1-1 interruption

timing_notes.horizon_limit: These rows cannot be described as forecasts before the original kickoff. The models do not condition on known partial scores, but final results are only added after completion.
timing_notes.pre_metric_diagnostic: Additionally report Italy fixed-model metrics excluding I1:2024:Fiorentina:Inter (759rows), without any refit or selection change. Retain the complete760match population as primary.
timing_notes.primary_population: Keep all380matches per target season; use source completion-day timestamps and next-local-midnight result availability
timing_notes.scope: Targeted known-resumption checks, not an exhaustive historical event audit
